results.case: A node is killed mid-transfer - the sender, the receiver and the quorum, each just after the transfer is initiated and again just after consensus - and the fleet must put itself right
results.expected: After each kill the node recovers, its machine's other nodes keep their IPFS, and no token is lost or left stuck
results.actual: 6 of 6 kill scenario(s) left the fleet wrong: sender after initiating; sender after consensus; quorum after initiating; quorum after consensus; receiver after initiating; receiver after consensus
results.note: sender after initiating: killed on log marker; node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | sender after consensus: killed on timeout (marker not seen in 40s); node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | quorum after initiating: killed on log marker; node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | quorum after consensus: killed on timeout (marker not seen in 40s); node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | receiver after initiating: killed 0.4s after dispatch; node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | receiver after consensus: killed 2.0s after dispatch; node back up; neighbours stayed up; RBT left Locked on Q | run once, without delay: time-boxed, so a delayed rerun would spend its window waiting for the fullnode

results.case: Audit every DID in the fleet and the faucet pair after the run and compare with AUDIT-START
results.expected: Total unchanged since the start; nothing locked or stuck; every token owned by one DID; no new counter drift
results.actual: the fleet is not clean after the run
